name: Spectra Intelligence MCP
description: Unlock a new level of threat intelligence with the Spectra Intelligence MCP Server. Built on ReversingLabs’ trusted Spectra Intelligence platform, this powerful integration connects both AI-driven agents and human analysts directly to a vast, continuously enriched threat intelligence database via RL’s hosted MCP server. Security teams can accelerate investigations, streamline incident response, and deepen threat research using purpose-built tools and skills designed for modern SOC workflows. Whether triaging alerts or hunting advanced threats, Spectra Intel transforms Claude.ai into an intelligent cybersecurity partner—delivering actionable insights with speed, scale, and precision.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spectra Intelligence MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spectra Intelligence MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.reversinglabs.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spectra Intelligence MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spectra Intelligence MCP provides these MCP tools: advanced_search, bulk_file_reputation_lookup, enhanced_threat_analysis, get_file_reputation, and get_network_reputation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spectra Intelligence MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Spectra Intelligence MCP in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.

_published_faq.name: Does Spectra Intelligence MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spectra Intelligence MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Spectra Intelligence MCP is developed by ReversingLabs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
